Why Random String Reversal Isolates Bottleneck Capacity
• Zero LM shortcut: i.i.d. uniform letters prevent guessing y_t' from y_<t'
• Worst-case lag for x_1: encoded at step 1, decoded at step 2T (survives 2T updates)
